rating_scale.0: No usable performance / cannot perform the target.
rating_scale.1: Major failure; meaning or target not achieved even with substantial support.
rating_scale.2: Partial performance; important errors or support still needed.
rating_scale.3: Adequate performance for the node level with independence or only a minor prompt.
rating_scale.4: Strong performance for the node level; accurate, clear or fluent as appropriate.

notes: Thresholds are conservative V1 product defaults, not psychometrically validated constants.
All thresholds must remain configurable and be calibrated from real learner data.
Review due or overdue does not automatically demote mastery; credible failed evidence can.
Low-confidence evaluation cannot promote or demote learner-node state.
